title: Hazel and the Choir
author: P. M. Brightwater
blurb: Jonah Nystrom, a bone-carver who hears the dead, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. Then tonight's date appears in a book of prophecies written a century ago — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must reforge a broken covenant between realms before the long winter finishes falling.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
